all_quotes.quote: the physical model presented in this paper is not able to reproduce the complex spectra at the center of Sgr B2(M).
The comparison of the observed and simulated map shows that the emission obtained from the physical model exhibits in general the same morphology as the observed emission.
This suggests that the gas temperature is not coupled to the dust temperature and should be higher in some regions , although it is not drastically underestimated.
